title: Oasis-360 — Open-Field Surround Dancefloor System for EDM
description: Complete open-field EDM sound system creating an enveloping 16×16 m surround sweet spot: pairing a tightly mouth-coupled North Cardioid Horn-Sub Monoblock (26–85 Hz) with 4 elevated Corner 3-Way Synergy Horn Tops (85 Hz–20 kHz).
design_notes: Why Separate Sub Coupling from 4-Corner Surround Tops? Human hearing cannot localize <80 Hz sub-bass, and putting 1 sub in each corner (Variant B) destroys 4× horn mouth coupling AND carves -18 dB checkerboard comb-filtering dead valleys every 2.5 m across the dancefloor!

Coupled Sub Blanket + 360° Kick/Mid/High Immersion: Grouping all subs into one mouth-coupled North Cardioid Monoblock delivers +-2.1 dB seamless sub-bass across the entire dancefloor while the 4 elevated 60°×40° Synergy tops (-7.5° downward tilt from 2.85 m) bathe dancers in crisp 360° kick punch, synths, and stereo/quad movement without harshness.

DJ Booth & Open-Field Control: Cardioid rear subs drop 35–80 Hz boom in the North DJ booth by ~14 dB, while the -7.5° downward horn tilt aims mid/high energy onto the dancefloor turf rather than miles across the open field.
